newsitem.title: USA: Albertson's raises dividend, buys back stock.
newsitem.headline: Albertson's raises dividend, buys back stock.

text.p: Albertson's Inc said it increased its quarterly dividend to $0.16 per share from $0.15, and adopted a plan to repurchase seven million of its common shares.
The dividend is payable May 25 to holders of record May 2.
Under the stock repurchase program, the company may purchase and retire up to seven million shares between April 1, 1997 and March 31, 1998.

The timing and quantity of the purchases are at the company's discretion. This new program follows a previous program to repurchase up to seven million shares that expires March 31. In that program, 1.6 million shares have been repurchased and retired to date.
